REGISTER FREEVIEW PROGRAMME

A professional pathway into Goals FC

We assess more than talent. Players are evaluated on technical quality, tactical intelligence, physical readiness, mentality, discipline, teamwork and coachability.

Technical

First touch, passing, control, dribbling, finishing and position-specific execution.

Tactical

Decision-making, movement, positioning, transitions and ability to follow the team's principles.

Character

Discipline, attitude, communication, work ethic and response to pressure.

3-Day Trial Programme

DAY 1 — DISCOVERY & SCREENING
Registration • physical testing • technical testing • 1v1 • small-sided games • positional games • 11v11 • initial shortlist.
DAY 2 — TECHNICAL & TACTICAL ASSESSMENT
Position-specific work • possession • pressing • transitions • 4-3-3 attacking structure • 4-4-2 defensive structure • 11v11.
DAY 3 — FINAL SELECTION
Final technical assessment • competitive games • 11v11 • staff review • invitations to further Goals FC training assessment.

Trial Rules

Respect coaches, officials and players. No fighting, threats, abusive conduct or deliberate dangerous play. Arrive on time, follow instructions and provide accurate information. Registration is free and does not guarantee selection, a contract, registration or payment.
